landing.heroImageAlt: Autonomous mobile robots lined up inside an industrial facility
landing.title: Keep your automation moving.
landing.lead: Report an issue once, route it with the right site and operational context, and follow every update through resolution.
landing.noAccount: No account? You can still submit with your site code.

channels.title: Slack + web
channels.description: Create from /ticket or the support portal

siteAware.title: Site-aware
siteAware.description: Route every issue to its deployment context

timeline.title: One timeline
timeline.description: Keep status, updates, parts, and visits linked

how.title: From first signal to documented resolution
how.lead: Ripple gives customers and service teams a shared operating record without forcing every conversation into another spreadsheet.

site.title: Identify the site
site.description: Use the site code assigned to your deployment so the request reaches the right customer and facility context.

impact.title: Describe the impact
impact.description: Tell us what stopped, when it started, and which equipment or process is affected. Add photos, logs, or video.

track.title: Track the response
track.description: Follow status, ownership, engineer updates, parts requests, and field-service activity from one ticket.

prepare.title: Give the engineer a strong starting point.
prepare.lead: A concise report with operational context is more useful than a long message without asset or impact details.

checklist.evidence: Error text, photos, video, or logs

prepare.severityTitle: Severity should describe operations, not frustration.

severity.P2: Major degradation or urgent operational risk

record.title: One service record across the work.
record.lead: The same support case can coordinate software investigation, hardware evidence, spare parts, and onsite service without losing the original customer context.

triage.title: Structured triage
triage.description: Severity and production-impact fields help the service team prioritize the right response.

collaboration.title: Engineering collaboration
collaboration.description: Customer-visible updates and internal technical notes keep every handoff connected.

parts.title: Parts coordination
parts.description: Link spare-part requests and fulfillment progress directly to the support case.

reply.title: Reply from anywhere
reply.description: Answer questions, share files, or reopen a ticket from your account or your tracking link.

channels.slackBody: Run /ticket in your site channel to create a structured request without leaving Slack. Contact your DropletAI Account Manager if your site channel is not connected yet.
channels.webBody: Use your deployment's site code to submit from the web. If you do not know it, ask your Account Manager or email <email>support@dropletai.services</email>.

closing.title: Start with the site. We'll keep the work connected.

common.languageSaveFailed: The language changed on this device, but it could not be saved to your account.

publicFooter.tagline: Service coordination for industrial automation deployments—from first report through engineering response, parts, and field work.

confirmation.heading: Your support ticket has been created
confirmation.trackIntro: You can track your ticket status at any time:
confirmation.closing: Our team has been notified and will respond shortly. If this is a critical issue, please contact your site support channel directly.

resolved.heading: ✅ Your ticket has been resolved

update.closing: Reply from your ticket page so the right engineer sees it.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your Ripple password
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your Ripple account. Use the button below to choose a new password. The link expires in one hour and works once.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not request this, you can ignore this email. Your password will not change.

invitation.subject: You're invited to Ripple Support
invitation.heading: Welcome to Ripple, {name}
invitation.body: {inviter} invited you to the {company} support portal. Use Ripple to submit support requests, follow progress, and talk with the DropletAI service team.
invitation.expiry: This link expires in one hour and works once. If it expires, use “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page with this email address.
invitation.signInHint: After setting your password, sign in at {url}

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password.
forgotPassword.lead: Enter the work email associated with Ripple. If it matches an account, we'll send a time-limited recovery link.
forgotPassword.noAccessBody: Contact your DropletAI Account Manager or email <email>support@dropletai.services</email>.
forgotPassword.submittedBody: If an account matches {email}, a recovery link is on its way. Check spam or junk folders before requesting another email.
forgotPassword.formTitle: Where should we send the link?
forgotPassword.formHint: Recovery links expire and can be used only once.

resetPassword.unavailableTitle: We could not verify this recovery link.
resetPassword.unavailableBody: The authentication service is temporarily unavailable. Retry before requesting another link.
resetPassword.invalidTitle: This recovery link is invalid or expired.
resetPassword.invalidBody: Recovery links are time-limited and single-use. Request a new one to continue.
resetPassword.cleanupTitle: Your password was updated, but sign-out needs attention.
resetPassword.cleanupBody: We could not confirm that this recovery session ended. Do not update the password again. Try signing out, then contact DropletAI support if this message returns.
resetPassword.title: Choose a new password.
resetPassword.lead: Use a unique password that you do not use for another service.

invitationNotice.sent: Invitation emailed to {email}. The link works once and expires; they can always use “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page.
